verdict.rationale: iTerm2's own docs say a tab can be split vertically and horizontally into any number of panes in any arrangement. Its window/tab/pane hierarchy is built in, with Open Quickly and Global Search for moving between tabs and sessions, so no external multiplexer is needed. Built-in session restoration also keeps shells alive across crashes, and tmux integration is optional rather than required. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of tab management and pane navigation and resizing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pane and tab workflow.
